name: Hanani
overview: The name Hanani appears in Scripture associated with several distinct individuals who served God faithfully in various roles. He is mentioned as a brother of Nehemiah who was entrusted with overseeing Jerusalem due to his faithfulness and reverence for God (Nehemiah 1:2; 7:2). Hanani is also noted among the sons of Immer and as a priest and musician involved in worship with the instruments of David (Ezra 10:20; Nehemiah 12:36). These references collectively highlight Hanani as a godly servant involved in leadership, worship, and the spiritual life of Israel.
